objective.primaryRule: At every cutoff (C19, C21, C23, C24) the actual-profit role among the qualified independent members of ALL eligible ETFs (ETF and phenotype together; controls VGT and GDX on equal terms): the highest development centre net among members passing Q1-Q5, ties by the higher selection robust net, the lower centre DD, then the label; no qualified member -> no primary (cash). A new-ETF procedure (controls excluded) is reported beside it; transfer-lane members are informed and never selectable. The ETF shortlist for a possible 7B (<= 3 new ETFs) follows the frozen tiered rule of PROTOCOL.md section 9.5.

risk.denominator: one fixed $100,000 principal budget (not peak account equity)

budget.notes: Distinct new centre proposals: independent 1,024 per ETF per cutoff (2 paired seeds x 2 protected entry cells x (160 screen + 96 island)), 60 eligible ETFs x 4 cutoffs = 245,760; transfer lane 9 exact vectors x 60 ETFs = 540 centres at C24. No extension. Backend evaluations: the brief's hard ceiling of 2,000,000 fresh simulations including pilot, bench, parity, centres, neighbours, earlier cutoffs, stresses, folds, diagnostics and validation; archive hits counted apart. Worst cases: 6,821 per ETF x cutoff screen job (1,637,040 in all), 1,186 per ETF transfer job (71,160), reserve 60,000; the plan check refuses the freeze unless the ledger plus every remaining worst case fits (PROTOCOL.md section 7.3).

deviations.description: the primary at each cutoff is the actual-profit role among every eligible ETF's qualified independent members (ETF and phenotype); a new-ETF procedure is reported beside it; transfer members are informed and never selectable
deviations.justification: brief: Selection and historical tests 3 (ETF choice is part of optimization); Screening search (transfers are hypotheses)

deviations.description: Study 8 pipeline scaled to a bounded screen: per ETF per cutoff 4 lanes x (160 screen + one island of 96); rung 1 = 8 draws, rung 2 = 4 x 32 per lane; no rung 3 or refinement; selection 1 x 128 for <= 4 shortlist members; confirmation 3 x 128 for <= 3 picks
deviations.justification: brief: Planning budget and hard ceiling (60 ETFs x 4 cutoffs within 2,000,000); smaller early rungs are screening estimates only

deviations.description: one perturbation scope with common random numbers across every member and every ETF of a cutoff
deviations.justification: brief: identical ranges, grids, seeds and neighbourhood definitions across ETFs

deviations.description: Priority 3's pooled engine reused unchanged with only the Growth slot enabled holding the ETF's door; gates E1-E8 verify it trade by trade against the canonical runRiseTrading path with the true symbol on every eligible ETF
deviations.justification: brief: verify engine parity against the canonical Growth runner on controls and varied configurations

deviations.description: stricter: FULL never opened before FROZEN_SELECTION.json is sealed and committed, even for known native targets
deviations.justification: brief: reproduce known full-history targets only at the final authorized validation stage

deviations.description: no extension: every ETF gets exactly 1,024 proposals per cutoff; stopping = base budget exhausted (not convergence)
deviations.justification: brief: up to 2,048 under a frozen extension rule; the ceiling must hold the whole universe

deviations.description: the transfer lane runs at C24 only; earlier cutoffs repeat the complete independent universe screen and selection
deviations.justification: brief: informed transfers never enter a historical cutoff

deviations.description: not applicable: one Growth book alone per configuration
deviations.justification: standalone Growth per ETF (brief: Dates, accounting and scope)

deviations.description: promotion guard: 1/4 centre net at screen and rung-2 promotion; profit slots in lane picks, the ETF shortlist and the confirmation picks
deviations.justification: brief: protect center-profit alternatives alongside robustness and structural diversity

deviations.description: study-specific ETF-shortlisting rule (Tier 1 = qualified at C24 and own C19-C23 procedure supported; rank(P)+rank(R); <= 1 per cluster; <= 3) and futility rule, frozen before outcomes
universe rules: Study 9's D1-D5 plus D3b (amendment R1, before any performance screening): 60 eligible; untested GDXJ, OIH, XLRE, XLF
no incumbent-informed refinement lane; the informed lane is the brief's exact transfer lane (same predeclared exact vectors on every ETF, unchanged)
deviations.justification: a bounded screening; VGT's and GDX's incumbent refinements were done by growth140 and 4A
deviations.userAgreement: brief research/growth-etf-screening/brief/BRIEF.md 'Screening search': 'A small, separately counted informed transfer lane at C24, using the same predeclared set of exact existing Growth vectors for every ETF' and 'This is screening, not an exhaustive optimization.'
